verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Bring Aaron and his sons, the priests' clothes, the special oil for anointing, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of bread made without yeast.
Then gather the whole community at the door of the Tent of Meeting."
Moses did what the LORD commanded him, and the community gathered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Moses said to them, "This is what the LORD has commanded us to do."
Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.
He put the long shirt on Aaron and tied the belt around him. He dressed him in the robe and put the ephod on him. He tied the finely woven band of the ephod around him to hold it in place.
He put the chest piece on him, and placed the Urim and Thummim in the chest piece.
He put the turban on his head, and on the front of the turban he fixed the gold plate, the holy crown, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the Holy Tent and everything in it, to make them holy.
He sprinkled some oil on the altar seven times. He anointed the altar and all its tools, and the washbasin and its stand, to make them holy.
He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him, to make him holy.
Then Moses brought Aaron's sons forward. He dressed them in long shirts, tied belts around them, and put caps on their heads, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
He brought the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

Moses killed it and took the blood. With his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to make the altar pure. He poured out the rest of the blood at the bottom of the altar. In this way he made it holy and made it right with God.
He took all the fat on the inside parts, the fatty covering of the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, and Moses burned it on the altar.
But the rest of the bull, its skin, its meat, and its dung, he burned in a fire outside the camp, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Then he brought the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.
Moses killed it and splashed the blood all around the altar.
He cut the ram into pieces, and Moses burned the head, the pieces, and the fat.

He washed the inside parts and the legs with water, and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering with a pleasing smell, a gift made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Then he brought the other ram, the ram for making them priests. Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.
Moses killed it and took some of its blood. He put it on the bottom of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

Then he brought Aaron's sons forward, and Moses put some of the blood on the bottom of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then Moses splashed the blood all around the altar.
He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat on the inside parts, the fatty covering of the liver, the two kidneys with their fat, and the right thigh.
From the basket of bread without yeast that was before the LORD, he took one flat loaf, one loaf made with oil, and one thin wafer. He put them on the fat and on the right thigh.
He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons, and waved them in front of the LORD as a wave offering.
Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering. It was the offering for making them priests, with a pleasing smell, a gift made by fire to the LORD.
Moses took the breast and waved it in front of the LORD as a wave offering. It was Moses' share of the ram for making priests, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron and his clothes, and on his sons and their clothes. In this way he made Aaron and his clothes holy, and his sons and their clothes too.

Moses said to Aaron and his sons, "Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and eat it there with the bread in the basket for making priests, as I commanded when I said, 'Aaron and his sons will eat it.'
Burn whatever is left of the meat and the bread.
Do not leave the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days for making you priests are over. It will take seven days to set you apart.
What was done today is what the LORD commanded, to make you right with God.
Stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days, and do what the LORD requires, so that you do not die. This is what I have been commanded."
So Aaron and his sons did everything the LORD had commanded through Moses.
